ref.description: Identifier or store path the server resolved.

digest.description: SHA-256 of the cited artifact where it is a file.

lesson_id.description: UTC date and hour of creation plus a per-hour sequence.

rule.description: Required for arch-constraint, where it is the recurrence key and part of the duplicate key (Upstream Release, Duplicates); absent otherwise.

remedy.description: What would have prevented the mistake (Remedy). A submit parameter of every lesson the lessons role authors; the recurring-waiver lesson of lessons-capture is review_standard.

kind.description: check: a deterministic check to add; wire_check: an existing check that ran too late or not at all; review_standard: a judgment rule for the review roles; pointer: a reference to where the information was.

statement.description: The check, the standard, or the pointer, stated so that a plan can implement it.

check.description: wire_check: the existing check (its gate, test, or rule name) and where it ran; null for every other kind.

status.description: upstream_pending: an upstream-audience lesson awaiting the operator's reviewed release (Upstream Release); retired iff retired is set.

provenance.description: What the lesson derives from: a run artifact (log, report, diff), a tool return, or an audited operator action (a waiver, an abort). Required on every lesson.

derived_from_untrusted.description: Server-set, never a submit parameter: true when the facts of the task that created or revised the lesson delivered text marked untrusted, or a merged or cited lesson is true; once true it stays true (Derived from Untrusted Text).

audience.description: Server-derived by the audience predicate (Audience Classification); never a submit parameter.

last_filing_failure.description: Set when an operator-confirmed upstream filing failed; the lesson stays upstream_pending with unchanged content.

tool_version.description: Release version of the runtime that created the lesson.

revision.description: Counter of the current body; incremented by every body replacement.

sources.description: Evidence of the current revision's body.

revisions.description: Append-only history, one entry per revision (the last entry is the current revision); bodies of earlier revisions are not kept.

body_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the UTF-8 body of that revision.

merged_from.description: Lessons merged into this one by lessons.review (submit merge), in order; each merged lesson is retired with verdict merged and into naming this lesson, and the merge is a new revision of this lesson whose sources include the merged lessons (kind lesson).

by.description: queue_task_id of the lessons task whose judgment the server applied, or the operator principal.

claim.description: Set by the start.create-scope transaction of a plan started with a lesson among its sources; the lesson file stays in the store.

retired.description: Set by a retirement; the record outlives the retirement in the same file.

by.description: Step id, plan_id, entry_id of the start whose lesson premise retired it, lessons.review, or operator principal that retired the lesson.

into.description: merged and superseded: the lesson it was merged into or superseded by; null otherwise.
